repairs.danger: Destructive buttons use dangerStrong/onDanger and dangerPressed/onDanger; unread badges use dangerStrong/onDanger; IconButton numeric overlays reuse CountBadge.
repairs.primaryCounts: Chip, step and segment counts use onPrimary; existing primary/onPrimary and segmentThumb roles are retained.
repairs.criticalText: Critical Text instances can scale to 200%; essential labels wrap and action, status, OTP and quantity containers grow.
repairs.progress: StepIndicator switches to a compact current/total layout for seven steps or insufficient width; reduced-motion rail updates are static.
repairs.semantics: Native input value/submit and OTP behavior and Stepper quantity actions remain covered by tests.
